title: Fact envelope
description: Shape shared by every typed fact, validated before the kind-specific schema. Metadata stays open — unknown fields are a caller's business — but the fields Ecphoria itself reads must hold their shape.

paths.description: Code this fact is about. A fact that names paths is only offered to a task allowed to touch one of them.

external_id.description: The writer's own identifier, used for idempotent re-delivery.

provenance.description: Where this fact came from. `source` is what makes it checkable later.
